# `competitor_prices`

**Layer:** **synthetic** — generated by `scripts/synth/generate.py` for demonstration. Every answer that reads this table must say so (`V2-SYN-4`). Dates span 2016-09-01 to 2018-10-31.

Weekly competitor price for the 300 best-selling products.

**Grain:** product x competitor x week.

## Columns

| Column | Meaning | Unit |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `product_id` | Real product key. | text |
| `date` | Monday of the observation week. | date |
| `competitor` | competitor_a or competitor_b. | text |
| `price` | Observed price. | BRL |

## Join keys

- `competitor_prices.product_id = products.product_id`

## Caveats

- Independent of our prices: a valid control in an elasticity fit.
